cards.target: Se vuoi, possiamo uscire stasera.
cards.english: If you want, we can go out tonight.

cards.target: Le camere vengono pulite ogni mattina.
cards.english: Rooms are cleaned every morning.

cards.target: Magari avessi più giorni di ferie!
cards.english: I wish I had more vacation days!

cards.target: Magari potessi tornare indietro nel tempo!
cards.english: I wish I could go back in time!

cards.target: Magari capisse quanto è importante studiare!
cards.english: If only he understood how important studying is!

cards.target: Se avessi più tempo, viaggerei di più.
cards.english: If I had more time, I'd travel more.

cards.target: Se non costasse tanto, prenderei un taxi.
cards.english: If it didn't cost so much, I'd take a taxi.

cards.target: Se fossi venuto, ti saresti divertito moltissimo.
cards.english: If I had come, I would have had a great time.

cards.target: Se solo avessi più energia dopo il lavoro!
cards.english: If only I had more energy after work!

cards.target: Pareva che fosse primavera, con quel sole caldo.
cards.english: It seemed like spring, with that warm sun.

cards.target: Se i miei genitori fossero d'accordo, partirei subito.
cards.english: If my parents agreed, I'd leave right away.

cards.target: Se prenoti online, risparmi il venti per cento.
cards.english: If you book online, you save twenty percent.

cards.target: Se non dovessi lavorare, dormerei fino a tardi.
cards.english: If I didn't have to work, I'd sleep in.

cards.target: Se potessi scegliere, vivrei in una grande città.
cards.english: If I could choose, I'd live in a big city.

cards.target: Se devo essere sincero, non mi piace molto.
cards.english: If I have to be honest, I don't really like it.

cards.target: Se risparmi ogni mese, potrai comprare una casa.
cards.english: If you save every month, you'll be able to buy a house.

cards.target: Se non hai capito, te lo spiego di nuovo.
cards.english: If you haven't understood, I'll explain it again.

cards.target: Stavo dormendo quando il telefono ha cominciato a squillare.
cards.english: I was sleeping when the phone started ringing.

cards.target: Se non avesse paura di volare, viaggererebbe di più.
cards.english: If she weren't afraid of flying, she'd travel more.

cards.target: Se avessi una macchina, andrei al lavoro in macchina.
cards.english: If I had a car, I'd drive to work.

cards.target: I bambini vengono accompagnati a scuola con lo scuolabus.
cards.english: The children are taken to school by school bus.

cards.target: Vai a chiedere informazioni alla reception dell'albergo per favore.
cards.english: Go ask for information at the hotel reception please.

cards.target: Se non fosse per il lavoro, vivrei al mare.
cards.english: If it weren't for work, I'd live by the sea.

cards.target: Speravo che il pacco arrivasse prima del fine settimana.
cards.english: I was hoping the package would arrive before the weekend.

cards.target: Se il treno fosse meno affollato, viaggerei più spesso.
cards.english: If the train were less crowded, I'd travel more often.

cards.target: Se non fossi andato all'università, non avrei questo lavoro.
cards.english: If I hadn't gone to university, I wouldn't have this job.

cards.target: Voleva sapere se avessi già prenotato l'albergo per le vacanze.
cards.english: She wanted to know if I had already booked the hotel for vacation.

cards.target: Il meteo ha previsto che avrebbe nevicato per tutta la settimana.
cards.english: The weather forecast predicted it would snow all week.

cards.target: Affinché tu capisca, ripeto.
cards.english: So you understand, I'm repeating myself.

cards.target: Si può entrare senza biglietto?
cards.english: Can one enter without a ticket?

cards.target: La pizza è mangiata da tutti.
cards.english: Pizza is eaten by everyone.

cards.target: Non si corre nei corridoi dell'ospedale.
cards.english: No running in the hospital corridors.

cards.target: Dubitavo che lui dicesse la verità.
cards.english: I doubted he was telling the truth.

cards.target: Se potessi, lascerei tutto e partirei.
cards.english: If I could, I'd leave everything and go.

cards.target: Se non esistesse internet, come faremmo?
cards.english: If the internet didn't exist, what would we do?

cards.target: Vorrei che la guerra finisse per sempre.
cards.english: I wish war would end forever.

cards.target: Se solo le giornate fossero più lunghe!
cards.english: If only the days were longer!

cards.target: La medicina va presa dopo i pasti.
cards.english: The medicine must be taken after meals.

cards.target: In quel negozio si vendono prodotti biologici.
cards.english: Organic products are sold in that shop.

cards.target: Desideravo che tutto andasse per il meglio.
cards.english: I wished everything would turn out for the best.

cards.target: Speravo che tu arrivassi prima degli altri.
cards.english: I was hoping you'd arrive before the others.

cards.target: Se non avessimo litigato, saremmo ancora amici.
cards.english: If we hadn't argued, we'd still be friends.

cards.target: Si trovano ottimi ristoranti in tutta Italia.
cards.english: Excellent restaurants can be found all over Italy.

cards.target: Se non avessi paura dell'altezza, farei paracadutismo.
cards.english: If I weren't afraid of heights, I'd go skydiving.

cards.target: Se solo il gelato non facesse ingrassare!
cards.english: If only ice cream weren't fattening!

cards.target: Se stessi meglio, uscirei con voi stasera.
cards.english: If I felt better, I'd go out with you tonight.

cards.target: Spende come se avesse milioni in banca.
cards.english: He spends as if he had millions in the bank.

cards.target: Se potessi rinascere, farei le stesse scelte.
cards.english: If I could be born again, I'd make the same choices.

cards.target: Se si mangia troppo, ci si sente pesanti.
cards.english: If one eats too much, one feels heavy.

cards.target: Se avessi le ali, volerei sopra le montagne.
cards.english: If I had wings, I'd fly over the mountains.

cards.target: Se ti interessa, ti mando il link dell'articolo.
cards.english: If you're interested, I'll send you the article link.

cards.target: Se il tempo è bello, andiamo al mare.
cards.english: If the weather is nice, let's go to the beach.

cards.target: Se parlassi meglio l'italiano, troverei un lavoro migliore.
cards.english: If I spoke Italian better, I'd find a better job.

cards.target: Se fossimo usciti prima, non avremmo trovato traffico.
cards.english: If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have gotten stuck in traffic.

cards.target: Se non avessimo perso tempo, avremmo finito prima.
cards.english: If we hadn't wasted time, we would have finished sooner.

cards.target: Se proprio insisti, verrò alla cena con voi.
cards.english: If you really insist, I'll come to dinner with you.

cards.target: Cammina come se avesse il mondo sulle spalle.
cards.english: He walks as if he had the world on his shoulders.

cards.target: Se non piovesse, faremmo un picnic al parco.
cards.english: If it weren't raining, we'd have a picnic in the park.

cards.target: Se avessi un orto, coltiverei pomodori e basilico.
cards.english: If I had a vegetable garden, I'd grow tomatoes and basil.

cards.target: Se non avesse piovuto, saremmo andati in spiaggia.
cards.english: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone to the beach.

existing_tips: Sia is the subjunctive of essere, triggered by 'credo che'.
The subjunctive is triggered by 'penso che' (I think that).
Volere che + subjunctive expresses a wish for someone else's action.
Passive with venire: emphasizes the action happening regularly.
